notes: Keep-Going mode: for a big thread that keeps stopping, flip 'Keep going' on and HELM drives it back to work every time it stops, silently and with no give-up cap, until the thread says it genuinely cannot go further. The session panel now mirrors your Claude Desktop sidebar, so idle and cloud sessions show up instead of going missing. Plus a fix for a false 'NEEDS APPROVAL' flag on sessions that were actually thinking or running a long tool.
